data_mode_selection.comment: 1 for mode Adjusted, 0 for mode Raw

QC_selection.comment: select QC value(s) 1 good, 2 maybe good, 3 doubful, 4 bad

comment.R2threshold: Linear correction R2 coefficient : treshold under which LOCODOX suggests to apply Constant correction
comment.adjusted_error_rel: (relative): adjusted error is a % value:  doxy_adjusted + adjusted_error_rel*doxy_adjusted/100

comment.ok_inair_drift: 0 unactivate - 1 activate for drift calculation from WOA and for NCEP
comment.drift_fitPolynomialDegree: By default, the data drift is computed using the polynomial fitting (order 1, y ~ ax+b). The polynomial degree can be increased up to 3
comment.drift_PWLF_N: Number of linear segments for Piece wise linear fitting for Time Drift
comment.##_drift_depth_##: Minimum/maximum depth and step for calculating drift

comment.refUnit: precise the unit of your reference data (most of the time in-situ CTD) mL/L, milliliter per liter, milliliter/L, mumol/m3, micromole per m3, mmol/m3, micromole/m3, mumol/L, micromole per liter, mmol/L, micromole/L, mg/L, milligram per liter, milligram/L, mumol/kg, micromole per kilo, mmol/kg, micromole per kilogram, micromole/kg
comment.RefArgoFile: Reference data associated to a wmo

comment.isokC: 0 no carry over, we suppose that in air oxygen measurements are not biased by splash/ 1 with carry over
comment.inWaterMC: MC for the in-water samples, part of the surface sequence (or the profile sequence).(double, array)
comment.inAirMC: MC for the in-air samples, part of the surface sequence (double, array)
comment.ncepDoUpdate: 0/1 unread/read the ftp website to update your NCEP
comment.inAirMaxPresForTS: maximum depth for TEMP and PSAL selection as surface temperature and surface salinity

from_clim.comment: fill information used for NetCDF history section (WOA_YEAR) and gain/drift calculation (WOAfile)

comment.fontsize: tunes the font size on the plot, for both screen display and saving plots
comment.resolution: 0 : screen resolution, 100 : mid resolution, 300 : high resolution warning: the higher the resolution setting, the longer it takes to render your figure
comment.formattype: '-dpng', '-jpeg', '-ps',... all the fromattypeallowed by matlab for the print function (doc print for more information). in [].

comment.M_MAP_PLOT_BATHY: 0 unactivate /1 activate PLOTTING ==> Reading ETOPO2 File

online_requeriment.comment: 0 Open dialog box for questions, 1;%matlab prompt questions
